title: Cap. VI Arg. 10: foresight election empties the secret — Peter and Judas already explained
pass_a_gloss: All the Orthodox in this business of predestination and passing by have acknowledged such a secret, and reject Predestination from foresighted human acts by this argument, that it excludes such a secret. For if Peter was predestinated because he was foreseen by God as about to believe, and about to persevere in faith, Judas was passed by because he was foreseen as about to die in his unbelief, the reason of predestinating and of not predestinating will already be in the open, and will contain nothing of secret in itself.
pass_b_english: All the Orthodox in this business of predestination and passing by have owned that secret — and reject predestination from foresighted human acts just because that empties the secret. If Peter was predestined because God foresaw he would believe and persevere, and Judas passed by because foresaw he would die in unbelief, the reason for predestining and not predestining is already out in the open, with nothing secret left.
source_text: Omnes Orthodoxi in hoc praedestinationis et praeteritionis negotio tale arcanum agnoverunt, et Praedestinationem ex praevisis actibus humanis eo argumento rejiciunt, quod tale arcanum excludat. Nam si Petrus praedestinatus fuerit quia praevidebatur a Deo ut crediturus, et in fide perseveraturus, Judas praeteritus fuerit quia praevidebatur ut in sua infidelitate moriturus, ratio praedestinandi et non praedestinandi jam in propatulo erit, nec quicquam arcani in se continebit.
